quotes.name: Tara Ellison
quotes.quote: I'm not sure what you mean. I'm just here in Rockridge, and I'm not in a room with anyone right now.

quotes.name: Alma Vasquez
quotes.quote: To be honest, I don't really know much about Tara Ellison or her rise in Rockridge. I live in Laurel, and while I'm aware of the general vibe around Oakland, I don't have a clear view of what's going on in Rockridge. I do see that there are a lot of cultural figures rising in fame, and that's interesting. Sometimes when I'm driving through other neighborhoods, I catch snippets of the local culture, like the bassline from a car at the stoplight here in Laurel.

quotes.name: Nina Reyes
quotes.quote: To be honest, I haven't really thought about Tara Ellison's fame or what's happening over in Rockridge. I've just been focusing on my own life and things here in Fruitvale.
